hooks.text: 沿巨树树干与枝杈向上建城，用滑索楼梯连接层级
hooks.excerpt: Build your city upwards, utilizing both trunk and bough. Limited horizontal space requires a strategy; construct zip lines and stairways to connect your growing settlement layers.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 迷雾让居民疯狂，必须靠光路、光能武器和Solium反推黑暗
hooks.excerpt: Fog drives your citizens to madness and conceals stalking terrors. Fight back by illuminating paths, crafting light-powered weapons , and mastering the raw energy of Solium.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 小决定也会滚成惨烈后果，20小时战役走向分支叙事
hooks.excerpt: Shape your citizens' destiny through morally complex decisions . Witness various dramatic storylines. Navigate choices where even small actions can spiral into grim consequences. Campaign Mode: 20+ hours of single-player, story-driven gameplay with quests, branching narratives, and high-stakes choices.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 配音表现令人感觉怪异。

excerpts.excerpt: Voice acting is... weird to put it mildly
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 长距离防护资源链与资源耗尽后频繁迁移的要求互相冲突。

excerpts.excerpt: The game asks you to build long protected resource chains across the map, but at the same time resources get depleted and you constantly have to move gathering areas.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 大地图镜头移动太慢，且缺少足够的缩放视野。

excerpts.excerpt: The overworld map camera is too slow and lack a decent zoom out view.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 中文文本缺字严重，直接影响剧情与对话阅读。

excerpts.excerpt: 中文版出现严重的缺字情况（角色对话、剧情等），超级影响阅读不知道想说什么
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 大量敌人相关漏洞会破坏正常流程。

excerpts.excerpt: The game has a lot of bugs, especially when it comes to enemies.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 战役后半段的节奏与难度成长很差。

excerpts.excerpt: Terrible pacing and difficulty scaling after the halfway mark of the campaign.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 理解系统后能获得真正愉快的游玩时刻。

excerpts.excerpt: I did have some genuinely enjoyable moments once I started to understand how everything works.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 总体玩法被评价为确实好玩。
基础建造机制直观，易于理解。

excerpts.excerpt: Most base mechanics are nice and intuitive.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 原料直接使用或等待精炼的取舍增加了基地管理决策。

excerpts.excerpt: The advanced resources are a nice touch for base management decisions, use the inefficient raw materials or wait to refine them first?
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。
